$comment: Backend tenant overlay schema. TenantInsightsConfig validates _base, validates the chosen tenant's insights.yaml against the schema, then layers _base.correlations + tenant.correlations into the final list. Strict mode: any file in tenants/<id>/ not declared in overridable OR tenantOnly causes startup to fail.

kia.description: Kia India dealer-audit tenant. 627 dealerships, NADA-style checksheet. See tenants/kia/docs/uat-kia-seed-runbook.md.

honda.description: Honda US Road to Sale pilot. NADA Road to Sale 10-step checksheet, voice-engine cue detection extensions (V1.34). See src/main/resources/db/tenants/honda/README.md.

overridable.description: BI dashboard AI-insight correlation pairs. Each correlation declares two element/question patterns and a message template; the backend computes co-occurrence percentages and renders the message.
Tenant feature flags consumed by TenantFeatureFlags. Currently: actionPlanRequired (boolean), scoreDisplayMode (CHAIN | CURRENT_ONLY).

tenantOnly.description: Tenant-specific demo SQL: creates demo operators + base auditees. Run via `psql -d smartcomply < ...`.
Tenant-specific Python seed script: generates a full audit dataset with photo evidence + AI calls. Not loaded by the backend.
Tenant-specific Python seed script: adds extra locations to dealerships for drill-down demos.
Tenant-specific Python seed script: backfills contextual auditor remarks across existing UCs.
Tenant-specific runbook: how to seed a fresh UAT environment for this tenant.
